verdict.rationale: Fathom is an AI meeting recorder, so recording in-person conversations from a mobile app is a fair question for this product. The evidence covers bot or bot-free capture of meetings and search across calls, but nothing mentions a mobile app or recording in-person conversations. Search across calls is an adjacent feature and earns no credit without the mobile in-person capture path.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace
